I tried to actually run `xcodebuild -list` to confirm the project still parses cleanly, but that command needs explicit approval in this sandbox and I didn't want to force it without you present — worth someone running a real build pass to confirm compile health before this gets called done.

If the release gate still fails after this, the next thing to check isn't my screens, it's whether `-uiTestSeedSession` is actually being passed by whatever's driving the crawler.
